"'''Without Me'''" is a song by American singer [[Halsey (singer)|Halsey]], released on October 4, 2018. Halsey wrote the song with [[Delacey|Brittany Amaradio]], [[Amy Allen]], and [[Louis Bell]], while production was handled by Bell. It interpolates [[Justin Timberlake]]'s "[[Cry Me a River (Justin Timberlake song)|Cry Me a River]]" and as such Timberlake, [[Timbaland]] and [[Scott Storch]] are credited as co-writers. It was released through [[Capitol Records]] as the lead single from Halsey's third studio album, ''[[Manic (Halsey album)|Manic]]''.<ref name="rs">{{cite magazine|url=https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/this-week-in-music-charli-xcx-troye-sivan-halsey-lil-baby-gunna-youtube-music-736554/|title=This Week in Music: Charli XCX feat. Troye Sivan, Halsey, Lil Baby and Gunna|last=Spanos|first=Brittany|date=October 12, 2018|magazine=[[Rolling Stone]]|access-date=October 14, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.mtv.com/news/3101032/halsey-without-me/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181005014208/http://www.mtv.com/news/3101032/halsey-without-me/|url-status=dead|archive-date=October 5, 2018|title=Halsey's 'Without Me' Is Her Most Personal Song To Date: 'I Cried The Whole Time'|last=Roth|first=Madeline|date=October 4, 2018|publisher=[[MTV News]]|access-date=October 14, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cosmopolitan.com/entertainment/music/a23603712/halsey-new-song-without-me-breakup-g-eazy/|title=Halsey's New Song Is Definitely About Her Breakup With G-Eazy and the Lyrics Will Wreck You|last=Baty|first=Emma|date=October 4, 2018|website=[[Cosmopolitan (magazine)|Cosmopolitan]]|access-date=October 14, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nme.com/blogs/nme-blogs/best-fan-theories-halsey-third-album-manic-2548325|title=The best fan theories about Halsey's next album 'Manic'|date=September 16, 2019|website=NME|access-date=November 29, 2019}}</ref>

"Without Me" reached number one on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]], becoming Halsey's first number-one single as a lead artist, and her second overall, following her feature on [[the Chainsmokers]]' song "[[Closer (The Chainsmokers song)|Closer]]" in 2016. Like "Closer", it spent 52 weeks on the chart. The song also reached number one in Greece and the top three of ten other countries, namely Australia, Canada, Hungary, Malaysia, Portugal, Slovakia, Ireland, New Zealand, Singapore, and the United Kingdom. It also reached the top five in the Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Latvia, and Norway. Its music video, directed by [[Colin Tilley]], was released on October 29, 2018. The track is certified Platinum or higher in eleven countries including 8× Platinum in Australia and 9× Platinum in Canada, Diamond in the US, and Double Diamond in Mexico. The single was the number-one song of 2019 on pop radio in the US, the tenth biggest song overall of 2019 in the world, and the twelfth biggest song overall of the 2010s decade in the US.

Halsey performed "Without Me" live on a number of high-profile occasions; she performed it on ''[[The Voice (American TV series)|The Voice]]'', ''[[The Ellen DeGeneres Show]]'', ''[[Saturday Night Live]]'', at the [[2018 MTV Europe Music Awards]], at the [[Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2018|2018 Victoria's Secret Fashion Show]], at the [[2019 iHeartRadio Music Awards]], at the 2019 [[MTV Millennial Awards]], and at the [[2019 Billboard Music Awards|2019 ''Billboard'' Music Awards]].

[[File:G-EAZY - The Beautiful & Damned Tour.jpg|thumb|left|upright|"Without Me" is partially about Halsey's ex-boyfriend, American rapper [[G-Eazy]].]]
During a performance in London on September 23, 2018, Halsey teased visuals for "Without Me" before announcing it would be released on October 4.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Maine|first1=Samantha|title=Halsey teases new single 'Without Me' – watch – NME|url=https://www.nme.com/news/music/halsey-teaser-without-me-2383681|website=NME|access-date=October 23, 2018|date=September 26, 2018}}</ref> The song premiered on [[Zane Lowe]]'s ''World Record'' radio show on [[Beats 1]], and was followed by an interview about the song. It is her first solo song since her 2017 album, ''[[Hopeless Fountain Kingdom]]''.<ref name="beats1">{{cite web|last=Krol|first=Charlotte|title=Listen to Halsey's brand new single, 'Without Me'|url=https://www.nme.com/news/music/listen-to-halseys-brand-new-single-without-me-2386735|website=[[NME]]|date=October 4, 2018|access-date=December 28, 2018}}</ref>

"Without Me" was written by Halsey with Delacey, Edei, and Amy Allen;<ref name="ascap">{{cite web|title=Halsey – Without Me|url=http://www.ascap.com/repertory#ace/search/performer/Halsey/title/Without%20Me|publisher=[[ASCAP]]|access-date=December 27, 2018}}</ref> while its production was done by Bell.<ref name="tidal" /> It is a [[mid-tempo]] [[trap (music)|trap]]-influenced pop, [[Contemporary R&B|R&B]], [[Electro (music)|electro-R&B]], and [[Electronic dance music|club-pop]] break-up song,<ref>{{cite web|last=Richmond|first=Anna|title=Music Review: With Manic, Halsey Fearlessly Inhabits Her Myriad Parts|url=https://www.slantmagazine.com/music/review-with-manic-halsey-fearlessly-inhabits-her-myriad-parts/|website=[[Slant Magazine|Slant]]|access-date=May 15, 2022|date=January 17, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://abitofpopmusic.com/2018/10/04/single-review-halsey-without-me/|title=Single Review: Halsey – Without Me|date=October 4, 2018|work=a Bit Of Pop Music|access-date=December 1, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Bruton|first1=Louise|title=Halsey: Manic review – Deeply confessional, scathing and muddled|url=https://www.irishtimes.com/culture/music/halsey-manic-review-deeply-confessional-scathing-and-muddled-1.4138330|newspaper=The Irish Times|access-date=January 17, 2020|date=January 17, 2020}}</ref><ref name="rs" /> which comprises an atmospheric blend of synths and [[electropop]] beats<ref>{{cite web|last1=Hughes|first1=Mary|title=ALBUM REVIEW: Halsey reveals her bruised heart on 'Manic'|url=https://riffmagazine.com/album-reviews/halsey-manic/|website=RIFF Magazine|access-date=January 17, 2020|date=January 16, 2020}}</ref> in its production. The song's bridge contains an [[Interpolation (popular music)|interpolation]] of the pre-chorus of [[Justin Timberlake]]'s "[[Cry Me a River (Justin Timberlake song)|Cry Me a River]]".<ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/articles/news/pride/8478305/halsey-without-me|title=Halsey Nods to Justin Timberlake On Kiss-Off 'Without Me': Listen|last=Bote|first=Joshua|date=October 4, 2018|magazine=Billboard|access-date=October 14, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/halseys-breakup-song-without-me-733023/|title=Hear Halsey's Personal New Breakup Song 'Without Me'|last=Blistein|first=Jon|date=October 4, 2018|magazine=Rolling Stone|access-date=October 14, 2018}}</ref>

Online commentators speculated the song and music video are about Halsey's ex-boyfriend, [[G-Eazy]], as they had split not long before the release of the music video.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Cohen|first=Jess|date=October 29, 2018|title=Halsey's "Without Me" Music Video Documents a Toxic Relationship—and Stars a G-Eazy Look-Alike|url=https://www.eonline.com/news/981532/halsey-s-without-me-music-video-documents-a-toxic-relationship-and-stars-a-g-eazy-look-alike|access-date=April 14, 2021|publisher=[[E! sections.text:
thumb|left|upright|"Without Me" is partially about Halsey's ex-boyfriend, American rapper [[G-Eazy.]]
During a performance in London on September 23, 2018, Halsey teased visuals for "Without Me" before announcing it would be released on October 4. The song premiered on Zane Lowe's World Record radio show on Beats 1, and was followed by an interview about the song. It is her first solo song since her 2017 album, Hopeless Fountain Kingdom.

"Without Me" was written by Halsey with Delacey, Edei, and Amy Allen; while its production was done by Bell. It is a mid-tempo trap-influenced pop, R&B, electro-R&B, and club-pop break-up song, which comprises an atmospheric blend of synths and electropop beats in its production. The song's bridge contains an interpolation of the pre-chorus of Justin Timberlake's "Cry Me a River".

Online commentators speculated the song and music video are about Halsey's ex-boyfriend, G-Eazy, as they had split not long before the release of the music video. Halsey disputed these rumors after posting the reasoning behind the song on Instagram, explaining that the song is about several different relationships that she has either experienced or observed, and that the song is a reminder that "you shouldn't allow others to take advantage of you". However, in a January 2019 interview with Glamour, Halsey confirmed that the song is partially about him.

The song spent 29 weeks in the top ten of the Hot 100 and logged its 52nd (and final) week, one full year, on the chart on the issue dated October 12, 2019.<ref>{{Cite magazine|title=Without Me by Halsey {{!}} Billboard The Hot 100 Chart|url=https://www.billboard.com/charts/hot-100/2019-10-12?rank=33|access-date=2021-04-14|magazine=Billboard}}</ref> It was also the number-one selling song in the US for six weeks on the [[Digital Songs]] chart.<ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/pro/mariah-carey-ariana-grande-billboard-hot-100-top-10/|title=Mariah Carey's 'Christmas' Climbs to No. 3 on Billboard Hot 100, Ariana Grande's 'Next' Leads for Seventh Week|magazine=Billboard|access-date=2019-01-02}}</ref> In the UK the song peaked at number three, making it her third top five hit.<ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/pro/ariana-grande-thank-u-next-second-week-hot-100-number-one/|title=Ariana Grande's 'Thank U, Next' Tops Hot 100 for Second Week, Panic! It made Halsey the first artist since 2014 to replace themselves as No. 1 on the chart, and it also made "Eastside" the longest journey to No. 1 in the charts history.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.altpress.com/news/halsey-eastside-number-one-without-me/|title=Halsey's "Eastside" replaces "Without Me" at No. 1 spot on pop charts|date=February 25, 2019|website=Alternative Press|language=en-US|access-date=2019-03-06}}</ref> "Without Me" also became Halsey's third number one on ''Billboard''{{'}}s [[Dance/Mix Show Airplay]] Chart in its March 9, 2019, issue.<ref>{{Cite magazine|date=March 7, 2019|title=Halsey's 'Without Me' Hits No. 1 on Dance/Mix Show Airplay Chart|url=https://www.billboard.com/pro/halsey-without-me-dance-number-one/|access-date=2021-04-14|magazine=Billboard|language=en}}</ref>
sections.text:
"Without Me" debuted at number 18 on the Billboard Hot 100, on the issue dated October 20, 2018. With the debut of the music video, the song rose to number 12 on the issue dated November 3. The following week the song hit number 9, and on November 17, it reached number six. The following week, "Without Me" peaked at number 4, giving Halsey her first top-five single since "Bad at Love" reached number five in January 2018. On the issue dated January 12, 2019, "Without Me" reached number one, becoming Halsey's first number-one song on the Hot 100 as a lead artist, and her second overall, after her feature on "Closer" with the Chainsmokers in 2016. It fell to the runner up spot the following week but regained the top spot on January 26, 2019. It again slipped to number two on February 2, 2019, as Ariana Grande's "7 Rings" entered at the top of the chart. Additionally, Justin Timberlake and Timbaland scored their sixth and eighth Hot 100 chart-topper as songwriters, respectively.

The song spent 29 weeks in the top ten of the Hot 100 and logged its 52nd (and final) week, one full year, on the chart on the issue dated October 12, 2019. It was also the number-one selling song in the US for six weeks on the Digital Songs chart. In the UK the song peaked at number three, making it her third top five hit. Due to "Without Me" becoming number one, Halsey became the eighth woman to achieve multiple number ones on the Billboard Hot 100 during the 2010s. Billboard{{'}}s Jason Lipshutz stated, "there's no cheat code that 'Without Me' used to get to the top of the Hot 100 – it's just a really polished, successful pop single, the type that Halsey has been tossing out more and more frequently." In February 2019, Halsey's song "Eastside" replaced "Without Me" as number one on the Mainstream Top 40. It made Halsey the first artist since 2014 to replace themselves as No. 1 on the chart, and it also made "Eastside" the longest journey to No. 1 in the charts history. "Without Me" also became Halsey's third number one on Billboard{{'}}s Dance/Mix Show Airplay Chart in its March 9, 2019, issue.

sections.heading: Music videos
sections.wikitext:
A [[vertical video]] for the song was released on [[Spotify]] on October 12, 2018, and posted on YouTube on January 9, 2019.<ref>{{cite web|last=Hannan|first=Devon|title=Halsey drops emotional vertical video for "Without Me" on Spotify|url=https://www.altpress.com/news/halsey-spotify-without-you-vertical-video/|website=[[Alternative Press (magazine)|Alternative Press]]|access-date=October 23, 2018|date=October 12, 2018}}</ref>

The music video was directed by [[Colin Tilley]] and released on October 29, 2018. It features Halsey and a love interest go through the cycles of a toxic relationship. The singer said in a post to her Instagram, "The story is a reflection of a combination of relationships I've been in, or watched the people I love go through". She went on to say that, with the video, she is aiming to reassure people that it is not okay to be taken advantage of. The video features product placement by [[Beats Electronics|Beats]] and [[Yves Saint Laurent (brand)|YSL]].<ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/music/pop/halsey-without-me-video-watch-8482098/|title=Halsey Battles Through Dysfunctional Love in 'Without Me' Video: Watch|magazine=Billboard|first=Marina|last=Pedrosa|date=October 29, 2018|access-date=October 29, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/halsey-without-me-video-748552/|title=Halsey Survives Abusive Relationship in 'Without Me' Video|magazine=[[Rolling Stone]]|first=Ryan|last=Reed|date=October 29, 2018|access-date=October 29, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eonline.com/uk/news/981555/halsey-s-without-me-music-video-documents-a-toxic-relationship-and-stars-a-g-eazy-look-alike|title=Halsey's "Without Me" Music Video Documents a Toxic Relationship—and Stars a G-Eazy Look-Alike|work=[[E!News]]|first=Jess|last=Cohen|date=October 29, 2018|access-date=January 12, 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://productplacementblog.com/music/beats-orange-headphones-worn-by-halsey-in-without-me-2018/|title=Beats Orange Headphones Worn by Halsey in Without Me (2018)|work=Product Placement Blog|first=NA|last=NA|date=October 29, 2018|access-date=January 12, 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://productplacementblog.com/music/ysl-lipstick-used-by-halsey-in-without-me-2018/|title=YSL Lipstick Used by Halsey in Without Me (2018)|work=Product Placement Blog|first=NA|last=NA|date=October 29, 2018|access-date=January 12, 2019}}</ref>

sections.text:
thumb|Halsey performing Without Me at 2018 MTV EMAs.
On November 4, 2018, Halsey first performed "Without Me" live at the MTV Europe Music Awards. On November 8, Halsey performed the song live on the 2018 Victoria's Secret Fashion Show, which aired on December 2. On November 15, she collaborated with Sebastián Yatra and performed a remixed version of "Without Me" live at the 2018 Latin Grammy Awards. On December 5, she delivered another live performance of the song on The Ellen DeGeneres Show. On December 8, she performed "Without Me" live at Capital's 2018 Jingle Bell Ball at the O2 Arena in London. On December 18, the singer appeared on the finale episode of The Voice to perform the song with her dance partner Jade Chynoweth playing the role of her partner. The performance received criticism on Twitter for "being inappropriate for television," to which Halsey responded saying, "[I'm] very proud to have pissed off the homophobic viewers at home who missed the message." On December 31, she performed the song live at Dick Clark's New Year's Rockin' Eve 2019. In February 2019, she performed the song on Saturday Night Live, with fans questioning if she was referencing another artist with the performance. In March, Halsey performed "Without Me" live at the 2019 iHeartRadio Music Awards. In May, she performed the song live at the 2019 Billboard Music Awards.

web|url=https://www.youredm.com/2018/11/30/illenium-halsey-without-me-remix/|title=Illenium x Halsey Shine Together In "Without Me" Remix [MUST LISTEN]|last=Powell|first=Karlie|date=December 1, sections.text: In October 2018, electronic music artist Nurko and DJ duo Miles Away collaborated to produce their EDM remix of the song. On November 30, 2018, American DJ Illenium released the EDM remix of the song on Capitol Records. On January 9, 2019, the singer released a remix of the song featuring American rapper Juice Wrld, whose music inspired the track's "vibe". The Juice Wrld remix was later featured on Halsey's 2020 EP, Collabs.
